day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka Sagaal iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wehelka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jireen.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga.
homily:
Waxaa jira daqiiqado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arki kartaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta. Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo nala socda: waa sawirka 'xididada' ee Bawlos uu ka hadlayo akhriska koowaad. 'Rooted and grounded in love.' (Xidido ku leh oo lagu aasaasay jacayl). 

Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in xididdada nolosheenna ay ku dhex yaalliin jacaylka Masiixa. Bal ka feker geed weyn oo xididdadiisu ay qoto dheer yihiin. Marka dabayshu timaado, geedku wuu gariiraa, laakiin ma dhaco. Sababtoo ah xididdadiisu waxay ku dhex jiraan dhul qoyan oo nafaqo leh. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil xididdadiisu ay ku dhex yaalleen jacaylka qoyskiisa iyo jacaylka Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xuso in xanuunkan uusan ahayn khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwa weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' (Midna isagu midna waalidkiis). Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'I have come to set the earth on fire, and how I wish it were already blazing!' (Waxaan u imid inaan dhulka dab ku shido, oo sidee baan u jeclaan lahaa inuu hore u guban lahaa!). Dabkani ma aha mid baabi'iya, laakiin waa dabka jacaylka Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Waa dabka nafta u ooman inay Ilaah aragto. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil dabkaas qalbigiisa ku xambaarsanaa. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'That Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith.' (In Masiixu uu qalbiyadiinna ku noolaado rumaysadka). Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in xididdadaada ay ku aasan yihiin jacaylka Ilaah oo aan marnaba go'ayn. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa wiilkayaga Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, inuu nabad iyo iftiin ku dhex helo gacmahaaga, waxaan kugu baryaynaa Rabbiyow.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu baryaynaa qoysaska murugaysan iyo dhammaan kuwa culeyska wata, inaan siiso rajo iyo nasteexo, waxaan kugu baryaynaa Rabbiyow.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sacrament-ka, fadlan qalbigeeyga ku imow ruux ahaan. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa qalbigeeyga sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda gebi ahaanba kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Waxaan hortiinna Aabbaha u jilba-dhiganayaa, kaasi oo qoys kasta oo samada iyo dhulkaba ah loogu magac daray, inuu idin siiyo, sida uu u hodan yahay ammaantiisu, in laydin ku xoojiyo xoog xagga Ruuxiisa ku jira ninka gudaha ah, iyo in Masiixu uu qalbiyadiinna ku dego rumaysadka; in idinkoo xidido ku leh oo lagu aasaasay jacayl, aad awood u yeelataan inaad quduusiinta oo dhan la fahantaan ballaca, dhererka, dhererka iyo qoto-dheeraanta, iyo inaad ogaataan jacaylka Masiixa ee ka sarreeya aqoonta, si laydin ugu buuxiyo dhammaan buuxnaanta Ilaah. Haddaba isaga oo awood u leh inuu sameeyo wax aad uga badan inta aynu weydiisanno ama aynu qiyaasno, xoogga ka dhex shaqeeya aynu ku dhex nool nahay, isaga ha ahaato ammaanta kiniisadda iyo Masiixa Ciise ilaa qarni walba, weligiis iyo weligiis. Aamiin.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga. Ku farxa, kuwa xaqa ah, Rabbiga; mahadnaqdu waa u habboon tahay kuwa qumman. Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqa kataaradda; kataaradda tobanka xadhig leh u gabyi ammaantiisa. R. Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga. Waayo, erayga Rabbigu waa qumman yahay, shuqulladiisuna waa lagu kalsoonaan karaa. Wuxuu jecel yahay caddaaladda iyo xaqa; dhulku wuxuu ka buuxaa samaanta Rabbiga. R. Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga. Laakiin qorshaha Rabbigu wuxuu taagan yahay weligiis; qorshaha qalbigiisa, ilaa qarniyada oo dhan. Waxaa barakaysan qaranka Rabbigu yahay Ilaahooda, dadka uu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. R. Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga. Laakiin indhaha Rabbigu waxay saaran yihiin kuwa isaga ka cabsada, kuwa rajeeya samaantiisa, si uu dhimashada uga badbaadiyo oo uu u ilaaliyo xataa abaaraha dhexdooda. R. Dhulka waxaa ka buuxa samaanta Rabbiga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yidhi: “Waxaan u imid inaan dhulka dab ku shido, oo sidee baan u jeclaan lahaa inuu hore u guban lahaa! Waxaa jira baabtiis aan ku baabtiismi doono, oo sidee baan u murugaysanahay ilaa ay ka dhammaanayso! Ma waxaad u malaynaysaa inaan u imid inaan nabadda dhulka ku dejiyo? Maya, waxaan idinku leeyahay, laakiin waa qaybsanaan. Laga bilaabo hadda, reer shan ah ayaa kala qaybsami doona, saddex ka gees ah laba iyo laba ka gees ah saddex; aabbe ayaa ka gees noqon doona wiilkiisa, wiilna aabbihiis, hooyona gabadheeda, gabadhna hooyadeed, soddohna gabadha wiilkeeda, gabadha wiilkeeduna soddohdeed.”

day: Thursday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
